name: 01_Base_with_intake_labyrinth
material: PETG or ASA: bench-fit use only
notes: 4 mm walls/floor; 40 mm alternating baffle gaps; support side openings; no exposed foam.

name: 02_Rim_and_baffle_gasket
material: Nonporous silicone, 1.5 mm free / 1 mm fitted
notes: CAD shows compressed thickness. Select actual material for emissions, cleanability and compression set.

name: 03_Removable_lid
material: PETG or ASA: bench-fit use only
notes: Six M3 screws; tighten evenly to compress rim and baffle gasket without warping.

name: 04_External_damping_layer
material: Viscoelastic damping sheet, external only
notes: No adhesive or damping material exposed to the air chamber.

name: 05_External_mass_plate

notes: 160 x 110 x 2 mm; bond over external damping layer.

name: 06_Isolated_blower_carrier

name: 10_Outlet_wall_grommet
